summary: The implementation addresses all five requirements with comprehensive backend and frontend changes. REQ-16 (video download) adds download buttons. REQ-17 (video likes) implements like functionality with state management. REQ-18 (comments) adds a full comment system with UI. REQ-19 (channel names) provides channel name management through profiles and settings. REQ-20 (quality selector) adds a quality selector UI component. All backend logic is in main.mo, and frontend follows the tech stack constraints. However, REQ-20's quality selector is UI-only without actual quality adjustment logic.

missing_requirements.requirement: Video playback adjusts to selected quality
missing_requirements.reason: The VideoQualitySelector component provides a UI for selecting quality options (360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p, auto), but there is no implementation that actually adjusts video playback quality. The component only updates local state (selectedQuality) without applying it to the video element or performing any quality switching logic.
